# mimecast_address_alteration_definition (Resource)

Manage one immutable Mimecast Address Alteration definition.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mimecast_address_alteration_definition" "example" {
  folder_id        = "address-alteration-set-id"
  address_type     = "envelope_to"
  original_address = "old-address@example.com"
  new_address      = "new-address@example.com"
  routing          = "inbound"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address_type` (String) Address component to alter.
- `new_address` (String) Replacement address pattern.
- `original_address` (String) Original address pattern to rewrite.
- `routing` (String) Mail route to which the rewrite applies.

### Optional

- `folder_id` (String) Optional Address Alteration Set ID. Root-level definitions omit this value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Mimecast Address Alteration definition ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mimecast_address_alteration_definition.example definition-id
```
